safety_health_committee_001.evidence: Employees shall report unsafe or hazardous conditions to their Building Administrator or immediate supervisor.

safety_assault_protection_002.evidence: Any member of the bargaining unit, acting in the course of his/her assigned duties, who sustains an injury of a duty-related assault, shall be eligible to “paid assault leave”

safety_student_discipline_003.evidence: The Student Behavior Plan and the Code of Student Conduct will be enforced in every school. safety_emergency_closure_005.evidence: On days that schools are closed due to extreme weather conditions or emergencies, the administration will make every reasonable effort to notify employees of the closing by 5:15am.
